description: This file defines and exports a utility function 'mergeMockedModule' used for testing purposes. The function asynchronously merges properties from the actual module with overrides generated by a buildOverrides function.

methods.name: export async function mergeMockedModule<TModule extends object>( mergeMockedModule
methods.description: An async function that takes an actual module and a buildOverrides function, then returns a merged object combining both, useful for mocking modules in tests.
